title: Better Sniffer
description: Adds different colored carpets for sniffers when renaming the name tag
body:
# Better Sniffer
This resource pack adds visual customization options for sniffers using a named tag system.

- Requires the **ETF (Entity Texture Features)** and **EMF (Entity Model Features)** mods.

## Available Names
| Tag Name | Variation Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Gena** | Rug with a creeper pattern |
| **Charlie** | Carpet with a chicken pattern |
| **Star** | A rug featuring a pattern of stars in the night sky |

## Installation
1. Make sure you have the **ETF** and **EMF** mods installed.
2. Download the resource pack.
3. Move it to the `.minecraft/resourcepacks` folder.
4. Enable the resource pack in the game settings.

by LadaLegends & UnHappyCorner1 & MickserYT
